subject: Polish foreign minister points out to Polish president that his decision was welcomed in Moscow
posts:
When internal political spats become a gift to the Kremlin. The Polish award controversy.
Evidence: Revoked award, Russian approval, Political friction.
#Poland #Ukraine #Russia
